Solutions to climate change often focus on phasing out fossil fuels, replacing them with non-fossil alternatives, or even discouraging the activities that use them altogether. events.title: I Have Never Really Quite Gotten Over Spence Lecture & Reading
events.description:
On 23 October 1966—exactly sixty years ago—Spence Mendenhall was found shot to death in his Salt Lake City home in the Avenues. His murder remains unsolved. Spence was a Gay man who was secretly out to some people but largely lived a closeted life, and his death has since been recognized as a hate crime.

events.description:
South African poet and novelist Mongane Wally Serote, born in 1944, was politically active against the apartheid regime. He was detained without trial and held in solitary confinement under the Terrorism Act. After earning an MFA at Columbia University on a Fulbright scholarship, he was barred from reentering South Africa, and he lived in exile in Botswana and London before returning to South Africa in 1990. A member of the African National Congress, he was elected to Parliament in the pivotal election of Nelson Mandela’s government in 1994.

events.description:
ABSTRACT:
The coming decades will see unprecedented changes to the Earth system with direct consequences for society. Changes in the characteristics of extreme weather are key indicators of future change, at both local and regional scales. The goal of this research is to advance our understanding of potential changes in the location, intensity and structure of such extremes (e.g., hurricanes) which is crucial in planning for future adaptation as these events have large economic and social costs.

Through this unique initiative, both generations create genuine connections and learn from each other. Meeting once a week over the span of eight weeks, these S&S Pairs share experiences, insights, and stories that bridge the gap between age groups. Time is also made for each generation’s participants to get to know one another, forming greater community, support networks, and friendships!

events.description: May 13, 2027Eight world class acrobats and one live musician investigate physical skill; how we obtain it, how we perfect it, and how it can transform our lives.
